title: The body of lintcrux <project> --json and of the lint tool
description: Present when the engines ran, whatever the outcome: when an engine failed (engine_error) the findings the others returned stay, marked partial by the outcome. counts and total cover every finding; findings is one page of them, in file, line, column, engine, rule, message order.

project.description: The .lintcrux file, absolute; null for loose source files.

timed_out.description: The watchdog killed it; its phase is failed.

counts.description: Findings no waiver suppressed, by severity, and the number suppressed.

truncated.description: More findings follow; ask again with offset + returned.

finding.description: The element of lintcrux --export json, unchanged but for absolute paths and raw always present, with signature and baseline added.

ruleId.description: engineId/ruleId; the rule tool describes it.

suppressed.description: A waiver or a source pragma suppressed it; it is not counted by severity and no gate fails on it.

raw.description: The engine's own facts (a CDC crossing's domains and registers), or null.

signature.description: crux-fnv1a64/1: FNV-1a 64 over ruleId|project-relative file|message, the baseline's fingerprint.

baseline.description: new or existing against the project's baseline; null when there is none, and for a suppressed finding.
